1. Bob is blue. (Fact)  
2. Bob is rough. (Rule: If something is blue then it is rough)  
3. Bob is red. (Rule: Rough things are red)  
4. Bob is big. (Rule: If something is red then it is big)  
5. Bob is quiet. (Rule: Big things are quiet)  

Since “Bob is quiet” is derivable, the statement “Bob is not quiet” contradicts the knowledge base.

ANSWER: False

8. Rule: If something is blue then it is rough. (blue -> rough)
9. Rule: Red things are rough. (red -> rough)
10. Rule: If Gary is rough then Gary is not blue. (rough(Gary) -> not blue(Gary))
11. Rule: Rough things are red. (rough -> red)
12. Rule: Big things are quiet. (big -> quiet)
13. Rule: All cold things are big. (cold -> big)
14. Rule: If something is red then it is big. (red -> big)
15. Rule: If something is blue and not rough then it is big. (blue & not rough -> big)
16. Rule: Quiet, big things are not cold. (quiet & big -> not cold)

Goal: Bob is not quiet. Determine if it can be derived or contradicted.

We have Bob is blue. From rule 8, blue -> rough, so Bob rough.

From rule 9? Actually rule 9 is "Red things are rough." So red -> rough. But Bob might be red? Not known. But we have rule 11: rough -> red. So Bob rough -> Bob red.

From rule 14: red -> big. So Bob big.

From rule 12: big -> quiet. So Bob quiet.

Thus we have Bob quiet is entailed. The statement "Bob is not quiet" contradicts entailed fact. So statement is false.

But we must check if there is any rule that could produce Bob not quiet or cause contradiction. Let's see: There's rule 16: quiet & big -> not cold. That would make Bob not cold. But that doesn't affect quiet.

Also rule 10: If Gary rough -> not blue. Only about Gary.

Rule 15: blue and not rough -> big. But Bob is rough, so this rule doesn't apply.

So we have Bob quiet is derivable. So Bob not quiet is not derivable. So statement false.

Thus answer: False.

We'll produce step-by-step derivations.

It might also be possible that Bob not quiet is not entailed. We only need to check whether it follows. Since we have Bob quiet, the negation is contradicted. So answer false.

We need to produce final answer: ANSWER: False.
